newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes eight cents down at 14.88 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes eight cents down at 14.88 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed eight cents down at 14.80 ringgit ($5.91) a kg in tandem with the overnight losses on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"There were high offerings after sellers followed through with the fall of the LME," said a trader.

Turnover fell to 79 tonnes from 93 on Tuesday. There were initial bids for 55 tonnes against offers of 114. Dealers said the local price fetched a premium of $100 against the LME, compared to $15 on Tuesday. Buyers were Europeans and locals.
